title: Opsis visual manifest
description: DRAFT for v2 (promoted in V5, ADR-034). One manifest format for built-in visuals (frontend/src/visuals/<id>/manifest.json) and imported visual packages (manifest.json in an .opsisviz file, which must also pass visual-package.schema.json). The editor builds field wells from roles and the config panel from configSchema; the backend and the agent use the same file to list visuals and check dashboard items. Changes from v1: `capabilities` is a list (v1 had an object of two flags), `author` is new, and the package fields are defined here.

id.description: Built-ins: equals the folder name. Packages: must not be a built-in id (or slicer), and should start with a short prefix of the author, for example acme_candlestick.

version.description: Semantic version. Dashboards record the version of a package they use.

roles.description: Field wells. Keys are role names used in items[].bindings. Use an empty object for visuals with no data (text).

configSchema.description: A JSON Schema (type object) for items[].config. Rendered with rjsf, so keep it flat and give every property a default.

aiHints.description: Guidance passed to the agent: when to pick this visual and its sensible limits.

capabilities.description: What the visual supports. crossFilter: clicking a mark selects values that filter other items. highlight: it can show a selection made elsewhere as highlighted marks (Edit interactions offers Highlight for it). drill: drilling through time grains on a time dimension. resize: it adapts its own height (host.requestResize).

sdkVersion.description: Packages: the SDK contract the bundle was written for, for example 1.0 (sdk/visuals/).

entry.description: Packages: the bundle, one self-contained ES module that exports create(host).

style.description: Packages: an optional stylesheet, applied inside the visual's frame only.

icon.description: Packages: an optional icon for the visual picker, at most 50 kB.

licence.description: Packages: an SPDX identifier such as MIT, or the name of a licence file in the package.

sampleData.description: Packages: a file of sample data in the SDK's data shape, shown in the playground before any dataset is chosen.

libraries.description: Packages: libraries the SDK provides inside the frame instead of the bundle carrying them, so packages stay small.

kind.description: What may be bound. A time dimension counts as a dimension.

types.description: Optional restriction on the dimension type, for example ["time"] for a line chart x axis.

axis.description: When true, each measure bound to this role may choose a value axis with {"field": ..., "axis": "left" | "right"}.
